notes.title: 🚛 Truck Parking Simulator VR – Version 2.0 Release!
notes.content:
🎉 Version 2.0 is now live!

🆕 What's new in this major update:

✨ Improved graphics for a more immersive VR experience  
🚚 2 brand-new American trucks added  
📦 Multiple cargo types to transport freely in the open world
☁️ Steam Cloud enabled – your progress is now backed up safely  
🛠 Various optimizations and bug fixes

This is the biggest update yet – thank you for your support and enjoy the ride in VR!

notes.title: Truck Parking Simulator VR Update
notes.content:
The game is compatible with Steam VR and tested on Quest 2 and Quest 3. We do not guarantee operation on other VR headsets because we do not have the possibility to test the game on all VR headsets.

For a better experience the game now has achievements.
